page.layout: One block of text on one printed page: running head at top, then a list of Latin and Greek word pairs in full lines, ending with a catchword at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ἰχθυοπώλης qui vendit pisces, ἰχθυοπώ-λαινα quæ vendit pisces.
Σκύθης Scytha, Σκύθις quæ est ex Scy-thia.
σκορπίος scorpius, σκόρπαινα & σκορπὶς scorpio fœmina.
Λίβυς Libys, Λίβυσσα Libyssa, quæ est ex Libya.
θεὸς deus, θεὰ dea: poëticé ὁ θεὸς, ἡ θεαινα.

page.notes: Greek and Latin word pairs are transcribed as far as legible; several Greek forms in the scan are faint and may contain errors. The catchword is read as printed.
